# Intake Brief — Remove Storyline text from top left (MS-0MUYAF2AD0066XO9)

## Problem Statement

The HUD renders a transient **"Storyline: …"** continuity-indicator label just
above the top-left of the info strip (`src/scenes/MainStreetRendererHud.ts`),
telling the player which storyline is currently in play. The producer wants
this text gone: it clutters the top-left of the screen and adds little value
alongside the Storyline journal and choice-dialog already surfacing storyline
context.

## Users

- **Main Street player** — sees a cleaner HUD top-left; storyline context
  remains available via the choice dialog (storyline name as dialog title) and
  the Storyline journal button/overlay.
- **Future example-game authors / designers** — unaffected; the removal touches
  only the HUD label, not storyline content, validation, or state.

### User Stories

- As a player, I no longer see a "Storyline: …" text floating at the top-left
  of the screen, so the HUD reads cleanly.
- As a player, I can still tell which storyline is in play through the existing
  choice dialog and Storyline journal, so no information is lost that matters
  at decision time.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] No "Storyline: …" HUD label is rendered: `MainStreetRendererHud.ts` no
      longer imports `continuityIndicatorLabel` and no longer creates the
      storyline label text object at the top-left position (above the strip's
      left edge). Verified by inspection and by the browser HUD test suite (if
      one asserts the label) — otherwise by code review of the removed block.
- [ ] The now-unused continuity-indicator code path is removed or left
      deliberately non-rendered: `continuityIndicatorLabel` and
      `getActiveStorylines` (and `ActiveStoryline`) in
      `src/MainStreetStorylineUi.ts` are removed if no other consumer remains
      (current grep: none). The AC3 continuity-indicator tests in
      `tests/main-street/storyline-player-agency.test.ts` are removed/updated
      so `npm test` stays green with **no dead exports** left in
      `MainStreetStorylineUi.ts`. Verified by a grep showing zero remaining
      references and a passing suite.
- [ ] The named-dialog, outcome-feedback, and journal features
      (`choiceDialogTitle`, `choiceDialogSubtitle`, `storyUpdateLine`,
      `buildJournal`, journal overlay) are **unchanged** — only the top-left
      HUD indicator is removed. Verified by the remaining
      `storyline-player-agency.test.ts` (AC1/AC2) and journal tests passing
      unchanged.
- [ ] All related documentation is updated to reflect the changes, including
      code comments, README, and any relevant wiki or docs site entries
      (notably the "Continuity indicator" bullet and cycle-continuity note in
      `docs/main-street/storylines.md`).
- [ ] Full project test suite must pass with the new changes.

## Constraints

- Presentation-only change: do not alter storyline content, validation,
  graph/manifest, or state transitions.
- Do not remove the Storyline journal overlay or the journal button — only the
  transient top-left HUD label.
- No new assets, no new styling work.

## Existing State

- `src/scenes/MainStreetRendererHud.ts` imports `continuityIndicatorLabel`
  (line 13) and, on every HUD refresh, renders a transient label at
  `(hudLeft, hudY - HUD_BAR_HEIGHT_PX / 2 - 10)`, `setOrigin(0, 1)`, styled
  `12px italic #ffcc88` (lines ~279–291). Output looks like
  `Storyline: Public Health Crisis`.
- `src/MainStreetStorylineUi.ts` exposes `continuityIndicatorLabel(state)`
  (builds the "Storyline: …" string, names ≤2 then "+N more") and its only
  helper `getActiveStorylines(state)` (`ActiveStoryline[]`). Nothing else in
  the repo consumes them (grep: only `MainStreetRendererHud.ts`).
- `tests/main-street/storyline-player-agency.test.ts` pins AC3 of
  MS-0MUMP96XH002SJ89 with a "continuity indicator state" describe block
  (empty / pending / successor / clear / cycle / multi / summary cases).
- `docs/main-street/storylines.md` documents the continuity indicator (bullets
  under "Player agency", and the cycle-continuity note in §6).

## Desired Change

- Delete the storyline-label render block and the `continuityIndicatorLabel`
  import in `MainStreetRendererHud.ts`.
- Delete `continuityIndicatorLabel`, `getActiveStorylines`, and
  `ActiveStoryline` from `MainStreetStorylineUi.ts` (and the `EventCard`
  import if it becomes unused there).
- Remove the AC3 continuity-indicator describe block and the two imports
  (`getActiveStorylines`, `continuityIndicatorLabel`) from
  `tests/main-street/storyline-player-agency.test.ts`, keeping AC1/AC2/AC4/AC5.
- Update `docs/main-street/storylines.md` (drop the continuity-indicator bullet
  and the §6 cycle-continuity reference).
- Note the removed capability in the same work-item's related PR summary for
  traceability of the MS-0MUMP96XH002SJ89 AC3 reversal.

## Key Files

- `src/scenes/MainStreetRendererHud.ts` — remove the `continuityIndicatorLabel`
  import (line 13) and the storyline-label render block (~lines 279–291).
- `src/MainStreetStorylineUi.ts` — remove `continuityIndicatorLabel` and its
  now-unused helpers (`getActiveStorylines`, `ActiveStoryline`), keeping the
  named-dialog/outcome-feedback helpers.
- `tests/main-street/storyline-player-agency.test.ts` — remove the AC3
  describe block and its imports; keep AC1/AC2/AC4/AC5 tests.
- `docs/main-street/storylines.md` — drop the "Continuity indicator" bullet and
  the §6 continuity note.

## Related Work

- **Potentially related docs:**
  - `docs/main-street/storylines.md` — the only doc describing the continuity
    indicator; must be updated with this removal.
  - `docs/main-street/ux-visual-audio.md` — HUD visual conventions; no storyline
    label mentions found, but check during implementation.
- **Potentially related work items:**
  - `MS-0MUMP96XH002SJ89` — *Named storylines, outcome feedback & continuity
    indicator* (completed): the feature that introduced this label (its AC3);
    this item reverses AC3's HUD surface while keeping AC1/AC2 and the journal.
  - `MS-0MUGRKEWZ0073327` — *Move level label to left* (completed): a card-face
    HUD-adjacent presentation tweak; unrelated code path but a precedent for
    small UI-only churn items.
  - `MS-0MUSY1S54000GPIT` — *Storyline management UI* (blocked): the editor
    workstream — verify no dependency on the HUD indicator.
- **Duplicate-work check performed:** `wl search storyline` /
  `wl search "continuity indicator"` found no open item asking to remove this
  label; MS-0MUMP96XH002SJ89 added it and is completed, so this is a new
  reversal, not a duplicate.

## Risks & Assumptions

- **Assumption (scope):** "Remove it" means the entire top-left HUD indicator
  — the rendered label **and** the pure helpers that exist solely to feed it
  (`continuityIndicatorLabel`, `getActiveStorylines`, `ActiveStoryline`), plus
  their AC3 tests. If the producer would rather keep the state-query helper as
  a future API, the change reduces to removing only the render block + label
  helper; flag this during review — it changes the test churn.
- **Traceability:** this reverses AC3 of MS-0MUMP96XH002SJ89. The AC3 comment
  in that item's feature code is removed with these files; note the reversal in
  the work-item comment/commit message.
- **No information loss at decision time:** the storyline name still appears as
  the choice-dialog title and in the journal; only the ambient HUD note is
  removed.
- **Scope creep:** do not remove or restyle the journal button/overlay, the
  choice dialog, or other HUD labels (score, week/year, favour buttons) as part
  of this item.

## Open Questions

- None blocking — the seed instruction ("There is a storyline text entry on the
  top left of the screen. Remove it.") plus grep of the HUD renderer located the
  exact block. The only judgement call (whether to also remove the pure
  helpers + AC3 tests) is recorded as an assumption above for confirmation
  during review.

## Appendix: Clarifying Questions & Answers

- No interview conducted — the work-item description plus repo inspection of
  `MainStreetRendererHud.ts`, `MainStreetStorylineUi.ts`, and
  `tests/main-street/storyline-player-agency.test.ts` provided sufficient
  signal to draft the brief. The helper/test-removal scope is recorded as an
  explicit assumption in Risks & Assumptions for producer confirmation.

## Related work (automated report)

### Related work items
- **MS-0MV14JDUG000E1V6** – Turn log no longer displays (completed)
- **MS-0MUZ6CGSV002WTYM** – Pedestrian polish: road lanes, deliberate shop entry, crowd persistence, end-of-turn walk-off (completed)
- **MS-0MUYLLW330044DB9** – Test: Mermaid→SVG render contract & drift guard (completed)

### Repository file matches
- `core/docs/the-build/genre-research.md` — matched: entry, left, remove, screen, storyline (+3 more)
- `core/README.md` — matched: entry, left, remove, screen, text (+2 more)
- `core/docs/DEVELOPER.md` — matched: entry, left, remove, screen, text (+2 more)

# Intake Brief: Improved money/reputation animation

**Work item:** MS-0MUYT57J80021CWW · `feature` · `medium`

## Headline

When coins and reputation pips fly to the HUD they currently land on
hard-coded coordinates (`gameW * 0.25 + 70` for coins, `gameW * 0.5` for
reputation at `hudY`) instead of the actual on-screen position of the
"Coins: N" / "Reputation: N" numbers. The flights must end at the location of
the painted coin/reputation number.

## Problem statement

The HUD strip renders `Coins: N` left-aligned at `hudLeft + 10` and
`Reputation: N` left-aligned at `favourBandRight + 40` (positions derived from
the SLL layout and viewport, not fixed fractions of the screen width). Every
market of the codebase that animates coins/reputation to the HUD instead targets
static hard-coded fractions of `gameW`, so the landing point only coincidentally
coincides with the counters — and drifts (most noticeably for reputation, whose
number sits near the right of a label that can be wider than the assumed
position) whenever `hudLeft`/`favourBandRight` or the number of digits change.
The animation reads as coins "missing" the counter.

## Users

- **Player.** When a turn ends and coins/reputation resolve, the flying
  visuals should land on the counter numbers so the income visibly accrues
  into the player's totals.

### Example user story

> As a player, when I end a turn and coins/reputation fly to the HUD, I want
> them to land exactly on the Coins/Reputation numbers so I can see the income
> arrive in my totals.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. **Accurate landing.** Every coin/reputation → HUD flight lands within a
   small tolerance (≤ 2px) of the on-screen centre of the corresponding
   numeric value — the coin number for coin flights, the reputation number for
   reputation pips — across the supported viewports and digit counts. This
   covers: end-of-turn income collection (`animateIncomeCollection` +
   `collectIncomeGrids`), the `upcoming` income phase (HUD coin/rep
   destinations), incident-reveal delta bubbles, and the sell refund coin fly.
2. **Single source of truth.** The HUD render publishes one live anchor for
   the coin number and one for the reputation number; all animators consume
   the published anchors. No `gameW * 0.25` / `gameW * 0.5` target literals
   remain in `src/scenes/MainStreetAnimator*`.
3. **Layout drift resilience.** Anchors are recomputed whenever the HUD is
   re-rendered (including viewport/window changes), so subsequent flights
   target the current number positions.
4. **Presentation-only.** The change never mutates game state, the turn
   transcript, or the deferred-mutation window; reduced-motion and
   replay/headless modes remain flight-free exactly as today. No change to
   flight pacing, staggered SFX, or the income-phase choreography.
5. **Tests + docs.** Unit tests assert flight destinations equal the published
   anchors (coin and reputation paths); a browser test asserts the published
   anchor matches the rendered number centre of `coinText`/`repText`. All
   related documentation is updated (including `docs/main-street/ux-visual-audio.md`
   and code comments). Full project test suite must pass with the new changes.

## Constraints

- Presentation-layer only (defensive `try/catch` style preserved — a failing
  animator must never stall the turn).
- Must not change phased income pacing (~11s collection) or the
  `incomeCollectionActive` / deferred-delta timing windows.
- Must not regress the HUD layout geometry guards
  (`hud-strip-layout`, `hud-market-geometry-guard` browser suites).

## Existing state

- `src/scenes/MainStreetRendererHud.ts` lays out `Coins: N` at `hudLeft + 10`
  and `Reputation: N` at `favourBandRight + 40`, computing
  `repX = repText.x + repText.width / 2` (centre of the whole label, not the
  number) and passing `coinX: hudLeft + 70` to `animateHudValueChanges`.
- Animators hard-code HUD destinations as fractions of `gameW`:
  - `MainStreetAnimatorIncome.ts` — `animateIncomeCollection` (`coinX =
    gameW * 0.25 + 70`, `repX = gameW * 0.5`), `runIncomePhase` `upcoming`
    (`hudCoin`/`hudRep`), `collectIncomeGrids` (`coinX = gameW * 0.25 + 70`).
  - `MainStreetAnimatorBoard.ts` — sell refund (`coinX = gameW * 0.25 + 70`).
  - `MainStreetAnimatorIncident.ts` — delta bubbles (`hudCoinX`/`hudRepX`).

## Desired change

- During HUD render, compute and publish the live coin-number and
  reputation-number anchor positions (numeric glyph centre, i.e. label
  origin + prefix width + number-width/2) — e.g. new fields on `SceneLayout`
  or transient scene fields set by `refreshHudStrip`.
- Replace the hard-coded flight destinations with the published anchors,
  falling back to the current approximate coordinate only when the anchor is
  not yet available (e.g. very first render).

## Key Files:

- `src/scenes/MainStreetRendererHud.ts` — compute + publish coin/reputation number anchors.
- `src/scenes/MainStreetConstants.ts` — extend `SceneLayout` (or add scene fields) for the anchors.
- `src/scenes/MainStreetAnimatorIncome.ts` — consume anchors in `animateIncomeCollection`, `runIncomePhase` (`upcoming`), `collectIncomeGrids`.
- `src/scenes/MainStreetAnimatorBoard.ts` — consume coin anchor for the sell refund flight.
- `src/scenes/MainStreetAnimatorIncident.ts` — consume anchors for incident delta bubbles.
- `src/scenes/MainStreetScene.ts` — anchor storage/reset lifecycle.
- `tests/main-street/income-collection-animator.test.ts`, `upcoming-flow-animation.test.ts`, `incident-reveal-animator.test.ts`, `sell-demolition-animator.test.ts`, `tests/main-street/hud-strip-layout.browser.test.ts` — destination assertions.
- `docs/main-street/ux-visual-audio.md` — document the anchor source of truth.

## Related work

- **MS-0MUYAESVU007X2U8** — "Coin and Reputation should count up/down"
  (in-progress, idea): end-of-turn reconciliation coins/rep fly to/from the
  HUD totals and the totals should count up/down as the animation plays.
  Complementary: that item animates the *numbers*; this item fixes where the
  flights *land*. Do not duplicate.
- **MS-0MTV9AS15004AC1E** — "Visual representation of reputation" (completed).
- **MS-0MUYGFWXK003QFYB** / **MS-0MUZ4WB290024ZGQ** — reputation income coin
  sources (pedestrian dissolve); origins only, destinations unchanged here.
- **CG-0MUA1UH3A008M4BS** — Upcoming/incident delta-flow routing (the
  `resolveDeltaFlow` destinations consumed by the upcoming + incident paths).

## Risks & assumptions

- **Assumption — scope:** "coins/reputation flying to the HUD" covers every
  flight path that ends at the HUD counters (income collection, Upcoming
  deltas, incident bubbles, sell refund). If the operator intended a narrower
  scope (e.g. income collection only), the ACs narrow accordingly.
- **Assumption — anchor:** "the location of the number" = the centre of the
  numeric portion of the HUD label, not the centre of the whole label.
- **Assumption — digit drift:** the anchor is captured at flight launch; a
  number that grows during a count-up animation is handled by the separate
  count-up/down work item (MS-0MUYAESVU007X2U8), not here.
- **Risk:** anchor absent on the very first render (`previousCoins === null`
  path) — mitigate with a conservative fallback to the current approximate
  coordinate.
- **Risk — scope creep:** do not fold number count-up/down animation,
  new SFX, or pacing changes into this item; record any such opportunities as
  linked work items instead.

## Appendix: Clarifying questions & answers

- Q: "Which flight paths are in scope?" — Answer (assumption, record by
  Map): all coin/reputation → HUD flights (income collection, Upcoming
  deltas, incident bubbles, sell refund). Source: work-item description
  wording "coins/reputation flying to the HUD"; repo inspection of all
  `gameW * 0.25 / 0.5` HUD destinations. OPEN QUESTION for the producer if a
  narrower scope is intended.
- Q: "What is 'the location of the coins/reputation number'?" — Answer
  (assumption, Map): the on-screen centre of the numeric value inside the
  `Coins: N` / `Reputation: N` label. Source: item wording; contrast with the
  current `repX` (whole-label centre) and `coinX` (`hudLeft + 70`).
- Q: "How should animators obtain the destination?" — Answer (assumption,
  Map): publish live anchors from the HUD render path; no duplicated
  hard-coded fractions. Source: outcome of duplicate-check + code inspection —
  the HUD already computes the real text positions.
## Related work (automated report)

### Related work items
- **MS-0MUWE6MSQ006DEZ4** – End-reason & player-state model (completed)
- **MS-0MUMP96XH002SJ89** – Named storylines, outcome feedback & continuity indicator (completed)
- **MS-0MUO7CPH3003TXFI** – Reduce time upcoming event is shown (completed)

### Repository file matches
- `core/docs/DEVELOPER.md` — matched: 2px, absent, acceptance, actual, add (+246 more)
- `docs/main-street/ux-visual-audio.md` — matched: 0mtv9as15004ac1e, 0mua1uh3a008m4bs, 0muygfwxk003qfyb, 0muz4wb290024zgq, 11s (+224 more)
- `core/AGENTS.md` — matched: absent, acceptance, actual, add, aligned (+208 more)
